people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
translations.bsb: The priest is to burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
